subject: Light Seal Room Three
text: Using the Lens of Truth in Light Seal Room Three reveals that the wall on the opposite side of the room is fake.

evidence.quote: Use the Lens of Truth, and you'll see the wall on the other side of the room is fake.

subject: Light Seal Orb
text: Walking through the fake wall reveals the orb, which must be shot with a Light Arrow so Rauru can appear and send Link back to the Keep.

evidence.quote: Walk through it, to find the orb.  Shoot it with a Light Arrow, and Rauru (remember Rauru?) will appear to send you back to the Keep.

subject: Spirit Seal Door
text: Going right from the Light Seal door and up the stairs leads to a door emblazoned with the Spirit Medallion.

evidence.quote: Go to the right from the Light Seal door, and up the flight of stairs.  At the top there is a door emblazoned with the Spirit Medallion.  Go through it.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: In Spirit Seal Room One, destroying the Beamos statue allows Link to Longshot to the ceiling target and claim the Silver Rupee above it, followed by a second Silver Rupee behind the Beamos.

evidence.quote: Destroy the Beamos statue directly in front of you with a Bomb or a Bombchu, then use the Longshot target on the ceiling to pull yourself up to the rupee above the (former) Beamos.  Take the second Silver Rupee from behind the Beamos.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: The three remaining Silver Rupees in Spirit Seal Room One are gathered near Blade Traps located in the corners of the room.

evidence.quote: Gather the three remaining Silver Rupees from near the Blade Traps in the corners of the room.

subject: Spirit Seal Room One Door
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in Spirit Seal Room One unseals the rear door.

evidence.quote: Once you have all five of the Silver Rupees, the door in the rear of the room will unseal itself.

subject: Fire Slug
text: Spirit Seal Room Two contains a pair of Fire Slugs that must be destroyed.

evidence.quote: Destroy the pair of Fire Slugs in this room, then look towards the steel bars on the left.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Hitting the Crystal Switch on the other side of the steel bars with a Spin Attack spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote: There is a Crystal Switch just on the other side.  Use the Spin Attack to activate the switch, making a chest appear.  Open the chest to get some Bombchus - the clue to solving this puzzle.

subject: Crystal Switch
text: Sending a Bombchu forward through the gap near the top of the bars activates the Crystal Switch between two torches on the other side of the room, unsealing the door.

evidence.quote: Stand back a bit, line yourself up with the crystal switch, and let loose a Bombchu.  It will go forward, through a gap near the top of the bars, and to the other side of the room, activating the switch....Go through the door after it unseals itself

subject: Spider Web
text: Burning the spider web on the ceiling with a Fire Arrow allows a beam of sunlight to shine into the room.

evidence.quote: Destroy the spider web with a Fire Arrow, and a beam of sunlight will shine into the room.

subject: Sun Panel
text: Reflecting sunlight with the Mirror Shield onto the sun panel to the right of the tunnel unseals the door, while other sun panels summon Wall Masters.

evidence.quote: Use the Mirror Shield to activate the sun panels in the room.  The sun panel you want is the one to the right of the tunnel you came through (if you face the sealed door, it's directly behind you and to the right).  The other sun panels will just make Wall Masters appear, who you must then defeat.

subject: Spirit Seal Orb
text: Shooting the Spirit Seal Orb with a Light Arrow causes Nabooru to appear, returning Link to the Keep and dispelling the barrier around Ganon's Tower.

evidence.quote: Destroy the Orb here with a Light Arrow, and Nabooru will appear and send you back to the Keep.  This should be the last of the six seals, so the barrier surrounding Ganon's Tower will disappear.

subject: Bridge to Ganon's Tower
text: Crossing the bridge to the left inside the Keep leads through the entrance door into Ganon's Tower.

evidence.quote: With the barrier around Ganon's Tower gone, head to the right until you see a bridge to the left.  Go across this bridge and through the door to enter Ganon's Tower.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Tower Floor One contains four Fire Keese that must be killed before proceeding up the spiral staircase.

evidence.quote: Kill the quad of Fire Keese in this room, then head up the spiral staircase to the left.  Watch out for the Fire Keese on your way up the stairwell.

subject: Tower Floor One Staircase
text: Climbing the spiral staircase in Tower Floor One leads to a door on the right at the top.

evidence.quote: head up the spiral staircase to the left.  Watch out for the Fire Keese on your way up the stairwell.  At the top, go through the door on the right.

subject: Dinolfos
text: Defeating both Dinolfos in Tower Floor Two unseals both doors in the room.

evidence.quote: You'll have to defeat both of the Dinolfos in the room before it will open....Once both of the Dinolfos are defeated, then the doors will unseal.

subject: Tower Floor Two Staircase
text: Climbing the Tower Floor Two stairs leads to a door on the left at the landing.

evidence.quote: Climb up the stairs, and at landing on top, go through the door on the left.

subject: Stalfos
text: Entering Tower Floor Three spawns two Stalfos around a large central pillar of flames.

evidence.quote: Step into the room, and two Stalfos will appear.  The large pillar of flames in the middle of the room makes fighting this pair of Stalfos a delicate matter.

subject: Ornate Chest
text: Defeating both Stalfos causes the central flame pillar to extinguish, revealing an ornate chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Once both of the Stalfos are dead, then the pillar of flames in the middle of the room will die away, revealing an ornate chest.  Open it to get the Boss Key.

subject: Tower Floor Three Staircase
text: Passing through the door behind the Boss Key chest and climbing the stairs leads to a door on the left.

evidence.quote: Go through the door behind the chest....Climb up the stairs, and at the landing on top, go through the door on the left.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Shooting one of the two Iron Knuckles in Tower Floor Four with an arrow awakens it individually, enabling the Backflip-Jump Attack pattern.

evidence.quote: If you shoot one of them with an arrow, then it will come to life and come towards you without disturbing the other.  If you wake them up one at a time in this fashion, then you can do the Backflip-Jump Attack trick, which they still haven't learned to defend against.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: If both Iron Knuckles on Tower Floor Four are accidentally awakened simultaneously, activating Nayru's Love is recommended.

evidence.quote: If you accidentally awaken both of the Iron Knuckles, then using Nayru's Love is an excellent idea.

subject: Tower Floor Four Staircase
text: Defeating both Iron Knuckles unseals the doors, leading up a staircase to a boss door on the left.

evidence.quote: Once both of the Iron Knuckles are defeated, then the doors will unseal themselves.  Go through the door that the camera focuses on.
Climb up the stairs, and at the landing on top, go through the boss door on the left.

subject: Pots
text: Tower Floor Five contains numerous pots that provide Magic Power and Recovery Hearts when broken.

evidence.quote: This room contains a ton of pots.  Smash them to find Magic Power and Recovery Hearts, if you need them.

subject: Tower Floor Five Staircase
text: Exiting the right door in Tower Floor Five and ascending the stairs leads through a boss door to the fight with King of Thieves Ganondorf.

evidence.quote: Go through the door to the right of where you came in to head further up the tower....Climb up the stairs, and at the landing on top, go through the boss door on the left.

subject: Ganondorf
text: During the fight against Ganondorf, Navi cannot Z-Target or offer advice until Ganondorf is stunned with a Light Arrow.

evidence.quote: Navi is unavailable during this fight, meaning you can't Z-Target and she can't give you advice with C-Up.  Once Ganondorf is stunned with a Light Arrow, then Navi can Z-Target again, but Navi becomes unavailable once more when Ganondorf recovers.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Ganondorf's lightning balls must be reflected back at him with sword strikes or Empty Bottles until he is struck and stunned, allowing Link to hit him with a Light Arrow.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf will throw balls of lightning at you, which you must reflect back at him with sword strikes (or you can use Empty Bottles if you're feeling creative)....Ganondorf will reflect the balls back at you as well, so keeping reflecting them until one strikes and stuns Ganondorf.  There is a new wrinkle to the fight at this point; you must now shoot Ganondorf with a Light Arrow, whereupon he will become stunned.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Equipping the Hover Boots allows Link to float across the collapsed floor pit to damage the stunned Ganondorf with a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: Quickly equip the Hover Boots and use them to cross the pit in the middle of the floor.  Just like in the Twinrova fight, use a Jump Attack when you're halfway across the pit to deal extra damage to him, then switch to normal attacks.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Shooting Ganondorf with a Light Arrow when he raises both arms to charge a large spell will immediately cancel the attack and stun him.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf will occasionally use a new attack where he will charge up a lot of power (you'll know when he's doing it, as he will hold up both arms to create the spell instead of just one arm for the Lightning Ball).  To stop him from using this attack, shoot him with a Light Arrow.  This will instantly stun him, letting you get in more attacks.

subject: Tower Escape
text: Following Ganondorf's defeat, Link and Zelda have three minutes to escape the crumbling tower.

evidence.quote: You've got three minutes to escape the tower before it is destroyed... with you inside.

subject: Tower Escape Route
text: Link must stay close to Princess Zelda as she navigates Tower Floor Five and the Tower Exterior ledges, because only Zelda can unseal the exit doors.

evidence.quote: Follow Zelda down the tower.  Only she can open the sealed doors on the way down, so there's no point getting too far ahead of her....Go to the left, keeping near Zelda to ensure that she keeps moving.  When she gets to the other side of the room, she'll open the door....Jump over to the ledge that Zelda stands on, and keep following her down the tower.  At the bottom, she'll unseal another door.
